#cloud-config
users:
  - name: root
    lock_passwd: false
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - {{ .PublicKey }}
{{- if .RootPasswordHash }}
    hashed_passwd: {{ .RootPasswordHash }}
{{- end }}
package_update: true
packages:
  - rsyslog
write_files:
  - content: |
{{ .NodeadmConfigYaml | indent 6 }}
    path: nodeadm-config.yaml
{{ range $file := .Files }}
  - content: |
{{ $file.Content | indent 6 }}
    path: {{ $file.Path }}
{{if $file.Permissions}}
    permissions: '{{ $file.Permissions }}'
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

runcmd:
{{- if .HostsEntries }}
  # Resolve AWS service and cluster endpoints to private IPs for private installation
  - |
{{- range $entry := .HostsEntries }}
    echo "{{ $entry.IP }} {{ $entry.Hostname }}" >> /etc/hosts
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- if .PrivateMode }}
  # nodeadm skips OS packages in private mode. The AL2023 repositories are served
  # from S3, so dnf works through the S3 gateway endpoint.
  - dnf install -y containerd iptables
  # New interface endpoints can take several minutes after they are "available" to accept
  # connections. Wait for them before running nodeadm, and log the result to the serial console.
  - |
    echo "=== private install diagnostics ==="
    cat /etc/hosts
    for host in ssm ssmmessages ec2messages sts eks; do
      for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
        if curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 5 "https://$host.{{ .Region }}.amazonaws.com/"; then
          echo "$host.{{ .Region }} reachable after $attempt attempt(s)"
          break
        fi
        if [ "$attempt" -eq 60 ]; then
          echo "$host.{{ .Region }} NOT reachable after 60 attempts"
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
    done
    echo "=== end private install diagnostics ==="
{{- end }}
  - systemctl enable rsyslog --now
  # Install Lustre client for FSx CSI driver support
  - |
    dnf install -y lustre-client
    echo -e "lnet\nlustre" > /etc/modules-load.d/lustre.conf
    depmod -a
    modprobe lnet
    modprobe lustre
  - /tmp/nodeadm-init.sh "{{ .NodeadmUrl }}" "{{ .KubernetesVersion }}" "{{ .Provider }}" "{{ .Region }}"
  - /tmp/nvidia-driver-install.sh

final_message: "The system is prepped, after $UPTIME seconds"
